title: Test the launcher's ~/.cargo/bin/engram default when CARGO_HOME is unset
outcome: Test the launcher's ~/.cargo/bin/engram default when CARGO_HOME is unset
acceptance: A launcher test asserts that sourceBinaryPath, with an environment containing neither ENGRAM_SOURCE_BINARY nor CARGO_HOME, equals resolve(homedir(), '.cargo', 'bin', <platform executable name>)
The assertion uses the runtime home directory and writes nothing outside the owned repository
A focused launcher check passes on the input that adds the test
